content: LH-CASE-001 is fully prepared for Human UAT testing. All technical prerequisites completed, database seeded, server stable, and verification artifacts archived.

uatCheckpoints: UAT-01 Entry: User can login and find their Reality
UAT-02 Understanding: User knows what is happening
UAT-03 Actor/Context: Clear who the work belongs to and workspace
UAT-04 Action: User knows what to do next
UAT-05 State: Status changes make sense after action
UAT-06 Evidence: Results leave visible proof
UAT-07 Recovery: User can recover from issues
UAT-08 Completion: User understands when work is done
technicalPreconditions: LH-CASE-001 seeded with correct participants and state history
metadata.instructionsForUAT: Provide real human tester with minimal instruction: 'Silakan gunakan sistem ini untuk melihat pekerjaan yang sedang berjalan dan lanjutkan pekerjaan tersebut.' Do not guide step-by-step. Observe natural understanding.
